sections.description: The core bridge between Exacoat Manager ERP, WooCommerce orders, custom status, and fulfillment tracking.
sections.changelog:
### Version 0.1.85
- Multi-source SliceWP REST API migration supporting creators, orders, commissions, and clicks
- Universal ?x={slug} referral tracking with 30-day attribution window and backwards-compatible legacy link support
- 7-day grace period rule for commission payouts after order delivery
- Cloudflare Turnstile anti-spam bot protection on registration and creator portal endpoints
